close_reason: Replaced match has_key_cert_sign { Some(true) => {} _ => return Err(...) } with if \!matches\!(...) { return Err(...) }.
description: chain_walk uses 'match has_key_cert_sign(cert) { Some(true) => {} _ => return Err(...) }'. This is the clippy::match_like_matches_macro pattern. Idiomatic replacement: 'if !matches!(has_key_cert_sign(cert), Some(true)) { return Err(...) }' — or equivalently '!has_key_cert_sign(cert).is_some_and(|v| v)'. The match-with-empty-arm signals a missed simplification to any experienced Rust reader.
title: match has_key_cert_sign(cert) { Some(true) => {} _ => ... } should use matches!()
